title: What Does Each Jamboree Buddy Do In Super Mario Party Jamboree?

quotations.text: This count of three turns begins when the buddy minigame is played
Daisy | Everything at any store is half-off.
Get 3–8 coins at the start of each turn.
Steal 3–8 coins from any opponent you pass.
Copy an item from any opponent you pass.
Get a random cheap item at the start
random spot on the board before each turn
Set a half-coin steal trap on any space you land on.
Boo will steal from your opponents twice
